tools.why: Enables the pdftotext extraction backend — the fastest path for text-layer PDFs, and the only one needing no Python environment or network access.

Rasterises PDF pages to images. Required by the tesseract OCR backend, the ollama vision backend, and the terminal page-preview renderer — without it those three are unavailable regardless of their own tools.
Enables OCR extraction for scanned or image-only PDFs, which have no text layer for pdftotext to read. Needs pdftoppm as well.
Carries the HTTP requests for the claude backend (Anthropic API) and the ollama backend's daemon check. Usually already present.
Enables the ollama backend: a local vision model reads rasterised pages, so scanned PDFs can be extracted without sending anything to a cloud API. Needs pdftoppm and a running daemon.
Renders PDF pages as images inside the terminal for :PdfPort preview, on terminals without their own image protocol.
